BitdefenderTenantTargets.description:
`[tenants.setup.targets]`: default targets for blocks that set none.

The same shape as a block's `targets` (`bitdefender_targets_shape`): exactly
one of the two lists, non-empty. A default never means "no targets": a tenant
that applies rules to the whole company leaves `targets` out.

configurations.router.json.title: opentide Configuration Router
configurations.router.json.description: Maps a file under .opentide/configurations/ to the JSON Schema that validates it. A file is a partial override: required keys apply to the merge of the bundled file, the workspace file and the parent instance. platforms/*.toml matches a platform file without a dedicated entry.
